triage.summary: Priya Shah, who runs a one-person design studio, asks whether Alex can automate copying Typeform responses into Notion. Her budget is around $200.

task.title: Reply to Priya about the Typeform-to-Notion automation
task.description: Priya Shah asks if Alex can automate copying client Typeform answers into Notion for her design studio. Her budget is around $200.

reply.body:
Hi Priya,

Thanks for reaching out. I can look into automating the Typeform-to-Notion workflow. Could you share a little more about how your Notion pages are structured and what information you’d like transferred? I’ll then let you know whether it fits your budget of around $200.

Best,
Alex
